title: easy to navigate and v helpful
body: overall, pretty happy even with just the free version! very helpful and easy to customise for your specific needs. lots of options and may consider premium one day as well. would also think it’d be cool to have widgets in the future :)
author: Almond Tofu :)

title: great app!
body: i've been using this app for almost 2 years now and i've been loving it so far! i don't really leave reviews that often but this app is a must have! the designs is so simple and the app itself is so easy to use! i love how i can view all my moods and habits in one page! 🤍 i really wish that the developers would add some widgets soon! ♥️
author: Freya Lesley

title: Can’t log in using apple ID
body: I previously use my apple ID (hide my email) to log in to this app. After the update the app logged me out but won’t let me sign in using apple ID (keeps going back to log in page). App is unusable now and i’m not sure what happened to my data.
